title: Targeting breast cancer stem cells by restoring RBM38 function: mechanism and protein delivery therapy.
snippet: Breast cancer stemness drives tumor progression and therapy resistance, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we observed that RBM38 expression gradually decreases during breast cancer progression in MMTV-PyMT transgenic mice.
